rows.diagnosis: ADJACENT: vitiligo (abstract says 'for the treatment of vitiligo'; [whether the treated lesions were stable or refractory to medical treatment is not in abstract; Background states only that surgery is indicated for 'stable vitiligo, refractory to medical treatment']); [not IGH]; Module 5-damage-repair lead
rows.design: pilot within-patient comparison, ReCell versus conventional MKT on lesions at the same anatomical localization (left vs. right, or two lesions at the same site); randomization and blinding not in abstract
rows.body_site: not in abstract (lesion pairs at the same anatomical localization; sites not named)
rows.skin_tone: not in abstract [Riyadh centre; skin type not stated]
rows.lesions_enrolled: five in this arm [5] (ten in the study [10])
rows.lesions_evaluable: five in this arm [5] (all five have a result in Results)
rows.intervention: ReCell kit (Clinical Cell Culture, Cambridge, U.K.), cell suspension [noncultured autologous cell suspension; 'noncultured' is not said of ReCell in the abstract]
rows.comparator: conventional melanocyte-keratinocyte transplantation (MKT) on the paired lesion(s)
rows.endpoint_definition: percentage repigmentation of each lesion at 4 months (per-lesion distribution)
rows.assessment_method: not in abstract (percentage repigmentation; method, assessor and blinding not stated)
rows.time_from_last_treatment: 4 months post-transplantation; [whether transplantation was the last treatment, with no adjunct phototherapy, is not in abstract]
rows.arm_result: ReCell, five lesions: two lesions 100%, one 65% and one 40% repigmentation, one lesion failed to repigment [4 of 5 lesions with any repigmentation]
rows.uncertainty: Diagnosis: [not an IGH study]; vitiligo ([stability and refractoriness of the treated lesions are not in abstract; Background gives 'stable vitiligo, refractory to medical treatment' only as the general indication for surgery]), a Module 5-damage-repair lead (cell transplantation precedent) entered at Gate A; it says nothing directly about IGH spots. [Module 5-damage-repair is not an allowed module in tools/ledger.py, so the row is filed under 1-hypopigmentation with an ADJACENT diagnosis, as elhoshy2025 and pagnoni1999 are.] Pilot within-patient comparison, five patients, five lesions per arm, no statistics in abstract. How repigmentation percentages were measured (area tracing, photographs, assessor, blinding) is not in abstract. Abstract does not state that each patient got one lesion per arm; [the 'left vs. right, or two separate lesions' wording suggests paired lesions, but pairing is not stated per patient]. Whether any phototherapy or other treatment followed transplantation is not in abstract, so time from the final treatment cannot be derived from '4 months post-transplantation'. Colour match and durability beyond 4 months are not in abstract. Conclusion says 'further research is required to establish the effective dilution of the cell suspension', [so the ReCell dilution used may not have been optimal]. Abstract does not say whether 'conventional MKT' was cultured or noncultured [the authors' group used noncultured MKT in earlier work, PMID 16207186, which is outside this source]. The bracketed '4 of 5 with any repigmentation' is counted from the listed lesions, not stated by the authors.
rows.citation: Mulekar SV, Ghwish B, Al Issa A, Al Eisa A. Treatment of vitiligo lesions by ReCell vs. conventional melanocyte-keratinocyte transplantation: a pilot study. Br J Dermatol 2008;158(1):45-9
